title: Vacuum Toilet Shroud Latch and Partition Bracket — Repair
abstract: Repair of a distorted shroud latch or a cracked partition bracket at the bowl interface, using the local replacement parts and the seating gap acceptance that follows the repair.

sections.purpose: This task gives the repair of the shroud latch and the partition bracket at the bowl interface, for the damage found during the servicing check or after a hard closure of the shroud.
sections.job_setup_note: Put the lavatory out of service. The repair replaces the latch or the bracket in place; the monument does not come out. Get the seal seating tool and the feeler gauge set. If the bracket seat in the monument is damaged as well as the bracket, this task does not apply and the monument repair scheme in the structure repair manual must be used instead.
sections.procedure: 1. Put the lavatory out of service and post the notice on the door. 2. Open the shroud access and remove the shroud. 3. Examine the latch and the partition bracket and identify which is to be replaced. 4. Remove the interface seal and keep it if it is within limits; a seal removed twice is scrapped. 5. Remove the damaged item. Keep the fasteners in the parts tray. 6. CAUTION: DO NOT ENLARGE THE FASTENER HOLES IN THE MONUMENT SEAT. THE SEAT IS NOT A REPAIRABLE FEATURE UNDER THIS TASK. 7. Install the replacement item on the existing holes and torque to the value in the table. 8. Seat the interface seal with the seating tool, working from the aft edge forward. 9. Refit the shroud and close the latch. 10. Measure the seating gap at four points and confirm it is less than 0.4 millimetres. 11. Do three flush cycles and confirm no airflow is audible at the interface. 12. WARNING: DO NOT RETURN THE LAVATORY TO SERVICE WITH A SEATING GAP OUTSIDE THE LIMIT. THE ODOUR PATH WILL RETURN WITHIN DAYS AND THE SEAL WILL SET IN THE WRONG SHAPE.
sections.close_out: Return the lavatory to service and remove the notice. Record the repair, the part replaced, the seating gaps and the flush result in the cabin defect log. Return the seating tool to the store.

safety_precautions: Put the lavatory out of service before you open the shroud.
Do not return the lavatory to service with a seating gap outside the limit.
